description.value: Poparide is a peer-to-peer carpool marketplace (not a scheduled operator) with active BC listing corridors including Vancouver-Whistler, Vancouver-Squamish, Squamish-Whistler, Kelowna-Vancouver, and Vancouver-Victoria. Drivers can optionally flag bike rack or bike space on their vehicle profile, but there's no platform-wide bike guarantee, fee, or boxing rule — space depends entirely on the individual driver, and riders are told to message the driver ahead of time to confirm room for a bike. Booking fee is roughly 20% of the trip price on top of the driver's posted seat cost. Because trips are driver-posted rather than scheduled, availability on any given day is not guaranteed.
